Bounty and your choices

Bounty for Android is operated by Kunal Das personally and is listed under the developer name Kudos Labs. The app identifier is io.github.kunal26das.bounty. Contact kunal26das@gmail.com for privacy questions or account requests.

You can use Local and Demo workspaces without signing in. Google sign-in connects an account for subscription access; it does not automatically upload Local or Demo ledgers. Cloud sharing, invitations, remote receipt transfers and automatic cloud-account deletion are paused. Previously saved Cloud ledgers can be viewed and exported, and pending changes remain saved on the device.

Audience and availability

Bounty is a general-audience expense-recordkeeping app intended for availability in countries supported by Google Play. It is not designed or marketed specifically for children under 13. Store availability, provider services and applicable rights can differ by country.

Use sign-in and purchase features only when you meet the applicable provider's age and consent requirements. A parent or guardian should assist where the law or provider requires it. If you believe a child's information was provided without appropriate authorization, contact support with the minimum information needed to explain the concern. Do not send a child's private ledger, passwords or verification codes.

Ledger and receipt data on your device

The app stores the information you enter: your profile name, currency and spending targets; group and participant names or optional email addresses; expense amounts, dates, categories, payer contributions and shares; settlements, notes, comments, recurring rules, receipt itemization, exchange-rate records and activity history. Private loan records can include loan and counterparty names, borrowed or lent direction, opening principal and date, supplied dues, repayment amounts and dates, principal/interest/fee classifications, applications to dues, reversals and notes. Selected receipt images or PDFs are stored as attachments in the workspace.

Local and Demo records stay in app storage unless you export, share or otherwise send them. Private loans are device records in Local or Demo; they do not change group balances or sync to Cloud. A ledger backup contains receipt references, not the attached image or PDF bytes. Keep separate copies of receipt files you need. Bounty does not read your address book or automatically import your other files.

Receipt text scanning runs when you request it. Android uses on-device ML Kit text recognition; review recognized text before saving. This path does not send receipt images to a Bounty OCR server.

Google's bundled ML Kit SDK processes installation identifiers, device and app information, and feature configuration, performance, usage and error information for diagnostics and usage analytics. On-device receipt recognition does not mean that the SDK sends no technical data.

Google sign-in and account information

When you choose Google sign-in, Google and Firebase Authentication process the request. Bounty receives an account identifier, provider identity and available name, email and profile-image URL. Bounty uses the Firebase user identifier to associate account access and subscription status. When displaying an available profile image, the app requests it from its HTTPS image host; that host receives ordinary network request information. Initials are shown when no image is available or it cannot load. Profile images are not saved to a persistent image disk cache.

Firebase Authentication processes technical information such as IP addresses and user-agent information for authentication and abuse prevention. Bounty can remember up to ten accounts on the device so you can switch without repeatedly opening the provider chooser while a saved sign-in remains valid. Android session secrets use Keystore-backed encryption. Signing out removes only the selected account’s saved sign-in and does not automatically select another remembered account. You can remove other saved sign-ins through the account menu. Removing a saved sign-in does not delete that account’s retained Cloud ledger or pending edits; those stay separately scoped on the device.

Accounts are not automatically joined by matching email addresses. Self-service account linking is unavailable; do not assume that signing in to another account transfers records or joins identities.

Subscriptions and service providers

Bounty uses RevenueCat and Google Play to obtain subscription options, validate purchases, restore access and check Pro status. RevenueCat receives the Firebase user identifier and purchase or subscription information, including product, transaction and entitlement status, along with SDK and platform information needed to provide its service. RevenueCat also provides purchase analytics. Bounty's billing adapter does not send ledger notes, expense amounts or receipt attachments to RevenueCat. RevenueCat can determine a country from a transaction or, when unavailable, the last-seen network IP address. Its documentation states that it drops the IP address after determining the country.

Google Play handles payment details for Android purchases. Bounty's billing adapter does not receive full payment-card details. Google, Firebase and RevenueCat have their own data-processing practices. Paid Apple and web offerings are unavailable; this Android policy does not promise cross-platform purchase continuity.

The Android app has no advertising SDK, advertising-identifier collection, cross-app advertising tracking integration or data-sale feature. It does not integrate a separate general-purpose analytics or crash-reporting SDK. This does not remove the account, purchase, support or technical processing described here.

Exports, sharing, support and security

You control when Bounty opens a file picker, exports records, copies text or invokes the system share sheet. Files or messages you send are handled by the destination you select. An export may include other participants' details, notes and financial records; review it before sharing.

If you export recorded loan due dates, Bounty creates a calendar file for unpaid dates on active loans in the next 12 months, up to 600 events. The file uses a generic recorded-loan-due label and excludes lender names, amounts and alarms. The file does not update after payments or schedule changes. Opening or importing it in another app is your choice; review old calendar entries yourself. Bounty does not schedule automatic loan notifications.

If you contact support by email, your address, message and attachments are processed to respond to your request. Send only the minimum information needed; do not send passwords, sign-in codes, authentication tokens, full payment-card details or unredacted private ledgers. Support records are restricted to the operator.

Bounty uses encrypted HTTPS connections for its authentication and subscription services. Device and account security also depend on protecting your device and Google account. The public information pages receive ordinary hosting requests, including network information; they have no analytics scripts, external fonts, embedded trackers or submission form.

Storage, retention and deletion

Local ledgers and attachments remain on your device until you remove or replace them. Signing out does not erase saved ledgers or pending Cloud changes. Device app-data removal can remove local records. Exported files and copies you send elsewhere remain outside Bounty's control.

We retain sign-in and subscription account records while your Bounty account exists. When a verified deletion request is fulfilled, we remove the account-associated records we control, except specific records retained for a legitimate reason as explained below. Support checks Firebase Authentication, RevenueCat customer identifiers and aliases, any configured downstream integrations and any pre-existing hosted Bounty data. Temporarily disabling an account is not completed deletion.

We delete raw diagnostic support attachments 30 days after a request is closed and retain a minimal ordinary-support summary for 12 months after closure to follow up recurring issues and document the response. An account-deletion request also covers those account-associated support records unless a specific legitimate retention need applies. For verification or deletion handling, we keep a separate minimal record for 90 days after completion to help protect against unauthorized account changes and resolve questions about the handling. A deletion request does not also receive a duplicate 12-month support record. These records contain only the necessary reference, relevant dates, actions and retention reasons, rather than reusable credentials or full private ledgers.

Where an active dispute, security or fraud-prevention need, or a legal obligation requires longer retention, we keep only the necessary records, document the specific reason and review when that need ends. We explain the affected records and applicable retention criteria in the request result. These exceptions do not permit indefinite retention of unrelated personal information.

Google Play may retain transaction records under its own obligations. Firebase, RevenueCat and other service providers have their own security, transaction and backup retention practices. Removing a Bounty account does not delete your Google account or erase independent provider records. We distinguish provider-controlled records from records Bounty can remove and explain any request that remains unfinished.

You can request account or associated-data deletion from Your corner → Request account deletion, through the Account and data deletion page, or by emailing support. Support independently verifies ownership and confirms the completed and retained data separately. We aim to acknowledge requests within 7 calendar days and handle them within 30 days; we explain additional verification, outstanding steps or delays. These aims do not limit applicable rights or guarantee that every provider finishes deletion within that period. An email composer or submitted request is not itself proof of deletion, and account deletion does not cancel a subscription.
